observations.behavior: The error message returned when Cloudflare API status is 401 or 403 was changed from a generic 'Invalid Cloudflare API token' to a more specific instruction: 'Your Cloudflare API token was rejected. Create a new token with read permissions in your Cloudflare dashboard, then reconnect.'
observations.code_quote: "Your Cloudflare API token was rejected. Create a new token with read permissions in your Cloudflare dashboard, then reconnect.",
observations.posthog_connection: This change improves the user experience for PostHog customers configuring Cloudflare Warehouse Sources. When authentication fails, the error message now explicitly instructs the user to create a new token with read permissions, rather than the previous generic advice to check permissions.
